newsitem.title: USA: Greenfield says work slows in soft market.
newsitem.headline: Greenfield says work slows in soft market.

text.p: Greenfield Industries Inc said Wednesday said business from its industrial and electronic groups slowed down in the third quarter as customers began lowering inventories in a softer market.
As a result of the softer markets, the company said it has reduced production in certain facilities, temporarily resulting in lower plant efficiencies and higher costs.

Greenfield President and Chief Executive Paul Jones said in a statement that in the short term the company is optimistic "that our historical industrial and electronics businesses will continue to improve from the third quarter order rate."
However, he said that the company's customers are "generally ordering on an as-needed basis and are not building inventories in anticipation of changes in the end markets."
